messages:
Nate G.: Quick thread to lock the final run-of-show and the live-demo fallback for next Thurs (Making inference affordable). Need a short producer-ready checklist.

Sofia M.: I can finalize the slide order tonight. Proposed change: show the cost-playbook slide right before demo so viewers see tactics then example.

Rae (ops): Ops checklist: dedicated demo VM, prewarm top 8 prompts, healthcheck every 20s. Fallbacks: 1) auto-route to rwd-8b-quant on 5xx>3 in 30s or p95>1.2s, 2) enable CDN canned responses for top prompts, 3) cut to 90s recorded demo.

Liam (growth): Lead routing confirmed: poll during Q&A -> prototype/product/regulatory. Product & regulatory get AE flag; prototype gets quickstart drip. I'll draft email snippets.

Nate G.: Run-of-show (40m):
0:00-0:04 host intro (Nate)
0:04-0:12 market + why serving (Sofia)
0:12-0:18 cost-playbook (Sofia)
0:18-0:28 demo (Rae + Nate)
0:28-0:36 panels + quick tips (Nate)
0:36-0:40 poll + CTA (all)

Sofia M.: Agree. Demo order: low-cost examples first -> high-quality last. Will cut slides to 1 sentence each.

Rae (ops): I'll upload recorded fallback to gs://redwood-assets/wbnr/affordable-inference-fallback.mp4 and create a private stage channel. Also will add a one-click toggle for the producer to swap demo route.

Nate G.: AV notes: mic check 10 min before, producer to run healthcheck command 3m before go-live. Example healthcheck: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck/demo -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY"

Liam (growth): I'll launch the registration A/B headers tomorrow and monitor CTR. Also prepping a 2-line registration blurb emphasizing the live demo.

calendar-bot: Calendar event created: Webinar  Making inference affordable  2026-05-14 17:00 UTC.

Nate G.: Action items recap: slides (Sofia, tonight), demo prompts + script (Rae, due EOD), recorded fallback upload (Rae, tomorrow), lead-routing copy (Liam, tomorrow). Rehearsal 09:00 PDT tomorrow. Confirm RSVP in thread.

Sofia M.: RSVP yes.

Rae (ops): RSVP yes.

Liam (growth): RSVP yes.

Nate G.: Great. Final run-of-show will be posted after the rehearsal. Thanks all! :clap:
